== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A pure core is a specialized spiritual center that contains [[pure madra]], an essence characterized by its delicate, light, and highly adaptable nature. Often appearing as a bright blue-white sphere in spiritual vision, [[pure madra]] serves as a foundational element that can strengthen the physical body and reinforce other types of [[madra]]. When blended with different [[aspects]], it acts as a diluting force, similar to [[water]], and can even empty out other elements through the principle of [[Emptiness]]. A unique strategic configuration involves a practitioner maintaining one pure core alongside a second core filled with a different [[Path]], such as [[Blackflame]]. This dual-core approach allows an individual to utilize the specialized abilities of a combat [[Path]] while retaining the versatile, foundational benefits of [[pure madra]]. While some may mistake a pure core for a disguise to hide other paths, it is a distinct and legitimate spiritual state. Practitioners can expand the capacity of these cores using techniques like the [[Heaven and Earth Purification Wheel]], which pushes against the core's boundaries to increase its ability to store power without the energy loss associated with other methods.}}
